register: Where the world map Astro's grey line is drawn on comes from
note: QGD-HOM-0002, page data version 6. Built into the window by scripts/build-map.mjs from the file below, fetched into vendor/ by scripts/fetch-map.mjs and checked against this SHA-256 sum. The file is not in this repository: the build keeps the coastlines as one outline, to a tenth of a degree, and nothing else.
decidedBy: KI7MT, 2026-10-22: a flat map with the terminator and the night greyed out, ours rather than a published image; Natural Earth's coastlines ship with the application, which its public-domain terms allow.

land.what: Natural Earth 1:110m land polygons. Public domain: "No permission is needed to use Natural Earth. Crediting the authors is unnecessary"; credited all the same.
